## A useful question

Write ordinary Markdown here. Bring in a plot sent from an analysis project with `to_post()`:

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| label: fig-main
#| fig-cap: "A caption for the figure."
#| fig-alt: "A description of the figure for screen readers."
from_post("my_fig")
```

Replace `my_fig` with the plot's name and remove `eval: false`.
